==============================================================================
PROCEDURAL SCI-FI SFX — FREE SAMPLER
==============================================================================

25 sounds spread across every category — the range, not the highlights.

25 sounds, delivered twice.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FOLDERS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  Masters_24bit_Stereo/
      24-bit / 48 kHz stereo. For editing, layering and further
      design work in a DAW.

  Engine_16bit/Mono_3D/
      16-bit mono. For anything your game positions in the world.

  Engine_16bit/Stereo_2D/
      16-bit stereo. For UI, menus and ambience.

The mono folder is not a size saving. Unity, Unreal and Godot build panning
and distance from where a sound sits in the world. A stereo file bypasses
that and plays flat wherever the object is, so everything meant to be
positioned ships mono. UI and ambience stay stereo because they are never
positioned.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
METADATA
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Every WAV carries BWF (bext) and iXML chunks with the description, category
and source. Soundminer, BaseHead and Reaper's media explorer read these
directly, so the library is searchable without importing anything.

manifest.csv lists every file with its category, generator,
duration and description, for scripted pipelines.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ENGINE SETUP
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

See ENGINE_GUIDE.txt for Unity, Unreal, Godot, FMOD and Wwise.
